entries.title: Explainable ensemble learning method for OCT detection with transfer learning
entries.authors: Yang J, Wang G, Xiao X, Bao M, Tian G
entries.approach_summary: Retinal OCT **image classification** (normal vs dry AMD vs DME): ensemble of AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet34 with ImageNet transfer; majority soft voting; Grad-CAM/CAM. Tiny clinical set (15 subjects per class). **Not object detection.**
entries.architecture_takeaway: Pretrain + ensemble + XAI for domain shift to a new imaging modality; tray/session finetune should use staged backbone freeze (see tfa2020, gandhi2025_yolov8_freeze), not full retrain from scratch.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer suggests transfer to fresh heads / field lighting. Paper is medical OCT **classification**, not seed object detection — valid only as **analogy** for source→target adaptation. Discussion draft: [reviewer gap §12](reviewer_comments_backlog_gap.md#12-manuscript-draft--domain-adaptation-plan-discussion) (**MS-DOMAIN-ADAPT** Done).

entries.title: Harmonizing physical and deep learning modeling: A computationally efficient and interpretable approach for property prediction
entries.authors: Ren D, Wang C, Wei X, Zhang Y, Han S, Xu W

entries.title: Unmanned aerial vehicle based multi-person action recognition via deep neural network models
entries.authors: Alshehri M, Zahoor L, AlQahtani Y, et al.
entries.approach_summary: UAV **multi-person action recognition** (MOD20, Okutama-Action; ~91.5% / ~89.7% accuracy): preprocessing, MediaPipe skeleton/keypoint features, DBN/CNN/RNN classifiers. **Not** object detection or detect-then-classify for static seeds.
entries.architecture_takeaway: HARCHOC deploy uses **classifier.pt gate → best2.pt detector** (two-stage). Manuscript should describe this explicitly and cite Alshehri only as a **robustness / staged-processing analogy**; HSP eval remains single-stage full-frame export.
entries.reviewer_alignment: Reviewer analogy (person detect → identify) is **conceptual**. Our gate rejects non-sunflower images before seed detection — cite as parallel staged pipeline, **not** the same task or metrics.
